assembledPrompt:
You have been provided with the produce-tech-design SKILL.md as your system prompt.

Execute the SKILL.md's complete workflow.

Slug: {slug}

Inputs (read from disk):
  - .dlc/{slug}/requirements.prd.md (FR-x / NFR-x source)
  - .dlc/{slug}/analysis_output/SECURITY_REVIEW_REPORT.md (if exists - Phase 2b finding)
  - .dlc/{slug}/designs/ux-review.md (if exists - Phase 2b finding)

The workflow should:
  1. Deep-explore the current codebase relevant to the requirements (parallel subagents).
  2. Synthesize high-level + low-level design covering: architecture, data model,
     APIs, modules, risks, decisions.
  3. Address every CRITICAL / HIGH security finding from Phase 2b.
  4. Incorporate UX wireframes from Phase 2b (if present).
  5. Produce stable IDs: WI-x (Work Items), D-x (Design Decisions), R-x (Risks).

Required artifact:
  - .dlc/{slug}/designs/tech-design.md

When done, print exactly: PRODUCE_TECH_DESIGN_DONE
Then list: number of Work Items, top 3 risks, any open questions for the user.
